name: Landbright · People from Shapes
description: A Shapes workflow's webhook (an employee created; a start date, termination date, department, job, office or manager changed) creates or updates the person in Landbright from the employee as Shapes has them now. A future start date makes a pre-hire; a termination date becomes their last day, after which Landbright deactivates them. Shapes tries a webhook once: the Shapes changes flow catches what one missed. Needs the hris and landbright plugins (spec 010).
